test_groupby_kurt_equivalence: test that groupby.kurt() results match per-group kurtosis calculations on a large dataframe
test_groupby_kurt_arrow_float64: test groupby.kurt() with pyarrow float64 and pandas Float64 dtypes
test_groupby_kurt_noskipna: test groupby.kurt() with skipna=False to verify NaN propagation behavior
test_groupby_kurt_all_ones: test groupby.kurt() with constant values returns NaN like DataFrame.kurt()
test_groupby_kurt_with_na: test groupby.kurt() handles missing values in float columns correctly
